name: Hellish Rebuke
summary: A reaction that wreathes a creature that just damaged you in green flames.

castingTime.trigger: in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

stats.effect: The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.
